t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes can score up to 7 points in each colour combo.Choose the one who gives more and keep choosing until 4 points. Then choose that colour.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes always appear in the same colour combinations. They can score up to 9 mushrooms. If one of the colour combination scores high it will do so for a number of goes. Then it will switch. This may be misleading as although this was the advice I received- it didn't seem to work. In fact in seemed a bit random. I would on reflection experiment with choosing left over right?
